name: Sooyeon Jeong
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
fitReason: Applied multimodal conversation, sentiment modeling and empirical HRI evaluation on an embodied social robot. A nonclinical software/evaluation project would need a separately agreed visitor appointment and scope.

physicalEvidence.summary: The September 2025 primary paper A Robot That Listens implements GPT-4o sentiment analysis and response generation on a physical Furhat robot, with prosodic-feature/rule-based backchannel timing. Sixty-five adults participated at the local campus. Sentiment outputs select verbal backchannels, facial expressions and gestures. This is an autonomous conversational pipeline with predefined behavior mappings; it is not reinforcement-learned motor control. Purdue's March 2026 feature confirms ongoing lab use of several physical robots.

shortVisit.summary: The full live Join Us page invites current Purdue students to inquire about projects, while non-Purdue students seeking MS/PhD positions are directed to degree admissions. A separate collaboration section addresses research groups, industry, domain experts and community partners. Neither section explicitly offers an external master's short visit. A listed visiting scholar is precedent only, with no summer duration or eligibility implied.

scoreReasons.fit: strong applied LLM, perception/affect and physical HRI overlap.
scoreReasons.physical: specific local Furhat deployment and 65-adult study, corroborated by current lab coverage.
scoreReasons.freshness: primary experiment is from 2025 despite a 2026 news feature. Provisional fit/evidence score, not acceptance probability or prestige.
